page.overview:
Who is Tully Jones?

Tully Jones is a tenth-generation Brujah and a staunch ally of the Camarilla spy Carl Wisor.

Embraced in 1944 at the age of 29, Tully previously served as a bomber navigator during World War II. A loner by nature, he claims no loyalty to the Anarch movement, nor does he serve the elders. In fact, Wisor is his only vampiric friend.

Tully is exceptionally bold and cunning. Serving as Wisor's last hope against the Sabbat, he is fully prepared to march directly into the midst of the enemy with guns blazing to rescue his ally.

Image: Tully stands 5 feet 9 inches tall and weighs 180 pounds. He has short black hair and still wears the same flight jacket he wore as a bomber navigator during the war.
